hard_gate_review.notes: Evidence is sufficient for a bounded strategy.
The thesis supports the primary business objective.
The operating burden fits known capacity.
No known ethical or legal conflict.

coherence_checks.item: Primary content pillar must center on the selected buying problem.

coherence_checks.required_change: Remove from core portfolio or justify as an experiment.

strongest_alternative_review.why_not_selected: It requires broader capacity and has weaker direct linkage to the current commercial objective.
evidence_that_would_reverse_choice: Repeated evidence that broad category content produces more qualified demand than the narrow proof-led territory.

premortem.failure_mode: The selected problem attracts interest but not buyers.
premortem.warning_sign: Engagement rises while qualified inquiries remain unrelated.
premortem.mitigation: Narrow the buying situation or revise the proof mechanism.

required_changes: Keep commercial outcome as an explicit experiment rather than a guaranteed result.
reversal_triggers: Repeated qualified conversations indicate a different problem is more commercially important.
